description: Hand the customer to roamflat to buy one Flat for a chosen number of days. Returns buy_url (the product page of that duration, where they tap Buy and pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; there is no discount-code field) plus the Flat name, the days and the total price in the customer's bucket or currency. No account needed; the eSIM is delivered on screen and by email right after payment. There is no in-chat order tracking.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code. Every price in the result is quoted in it.

days.description: Number of days to buy. Must be one of the Flat's durations; omit to buy the duration product_id stands for. When the exact count is not offered, the next longer duration is chosen and reported in days.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Titles, labels and country names come back in it when available. Bare "en" is quoted in en-us / USD.

product_id.description: Product id of the Flat (any of its durations).

name: start_checkout

app_links.description: Store links of the free roamflat app (android, ios) — the Flat works without it.

buy_url.description: The exact product page to send the customer to. Use verbatim.

product_id.description: The product id of the chosen duration.

total.description: TOTAL price for the chosen days — the amount paid.

title: Start secure checkout
